questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence In passive voice.

Joseph opened the Bible.

options.text: The Bible is being opened by Joseph.
The Bible was opened by Joseph.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**The Bible was opened by Joseph.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
 
• Example: The ball was thrown by Raju.
 
 
 
• **The verb in the given sentence, is changed to a passive form i.e. "opened" becomes "was opened."**
 
• **The subject of the active sentence becomes the object of the preposition "by" in the passive sentence.**
 
• So, "Joseph opened the Bible" in passive sentence becomes:
 
 
• "The Bible was opened by Joseph" in passive voice.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In option 1, "The Bible is being opened by Joseph," is also in passive voice but is in present continuous tense, indicating an ongoing action.
 
• In option 2, "Joseph is opening the Bible," is in active voice and present continuous tense.
 
• In option 4, "Joseph opens the Bible," is in active voice and simple present tense.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The ball of yarn was being nudged by the kitten.

options.text: The kitten was nudged by the ball of yarn.
The kitten is nudging the ball of yarn.
The kitten was nudging the ball of yarn.
The kitten has been nudging the ball of yarn.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**The kitten was nudging the ball of yarn.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In active voice, the subject of the sentence performs the action.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject (ball of yarn) is receiving the action (nudged) and the verb is in passive voice.
 
• **To convert the sentence into active voice:**
 
 
• **We need to make the subject (kitten) perform the action (nudging) on the object (ball of yarn).**
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence in active voice is "The kitten was nudging the ball of yarn."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Realise **(समझना) means to become fully aware of (something) as a fact; understand clearly.

 
 
• **Example**: He did not **realise **the gravity of the situation until it was too late.
 
 
 
• **Realise **in the context of the passage implies becoming aware or acknowledging something important - in this case, that complicated sentences can be difficult for students to understand.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **realise**.

Therefore, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guess **(मान लेना) means to estimate or suppose (something) without sufficient information to be sure of being correct.
 
• **Detect **(पता लगाना) means to discover or identify the presence of something concealed.
 
• **Decide **(निर्णय लेना) means to make a choice from a number of alternatives.

- Example: It is advisable to wear a helmet while riding a bike.
